name: Precarious Sojourn
title: Precarious Sojourn
summary: Alatar Locke's aerial retreat (Arcane Pedestal quest), reached only by portal from Al-Jalima: a chain of floating Empyrean octagonal platforms (24 m, 4 m thick), flat plank bridges and 10 m-rise ramps strung 75-160 m above a rugged Sho gorge at 38.1S 60.3W. In the kit the path starts at the drop-point ramp and exit portal (9996, 15313, z 90), runs north along x 9996, east along y 15468, loops round a 130 m rock pinnacle (10120, 15340-15400) and climbs to z 160 at (10260, 15348); fallen platforms lie at z 30-60, the gorge floor is 2-20 m, with crags up to 150 m to the west and south.

landmarks.name: Drop-point ramp and exit portal
landmarks.note: Ramp 0x010029F8 z 79-90; Precarious Sojourn Exit Portal; gazetteer teleport here.

landmarks.name: Plank bridge (FPV gap)
landmarks.note: Two flat 24 m bridges x 9994-9998, y 15360-15408, deck z 78-80, between octagons at y 15348 and 15420.

landmarks.name: Rock pinnacle
landmarks.note: Terrain spire to z ~132 inside the loop of platforms.

shots.standingOrder: Hang 30 m above the western crags 290 m from the floating walkways and drift slowly round them with the low sun behind the lens; keep 25 m above the rocks.
shots.notes: Signature view. Wide establishing from the western crags (camera z 160, 290 m out, drifting 10 deg and pushing 8 %): the whole chain of floating octagonal platforms, plank bridges and tilted ramps strung 75-160 m above the Sho gorge, winding around the 130 m rock pinnacle, the low western sun (0.74) directly behind the lens lighting every platform face. proj.mjs: the drop-point ramp, the highest platform (10260,15348,160), the east loop (10308,15444) and the pinnacle top all stay inside the frame for the whole take. Verified (check.mjs, full take flown): take 0-10 s: AGL 32.43..75.3 m, nearest drawn 30.34 m (scenery-default 0x02000258@9845,15461), vmax 8.46 m/s, LOS blocked 0/41, subject in frame 100% (retail-bake tree 125.7 m); edit 2-8.5 s: AGL 32.43..71.9 m, nearest drawn 30.34 m (scenery-default 0x02000258@9845,15461), vmax 8.46 m/s, LOS blocked 0/27, subject in frame 100% (retail-bake tree 126.3 m).

shots.standingOrder: Thread the FPV 7 m beneath the plank bridge between the two floating platforms, heading east toward the rock pinnacle, and exit 25 m beyond; never closer than 6 m to the deck.
shots.notes: FPV gap: approaches from the south-west at 13 m/s, banks onto the axis and threads 7 m beneath the 4 m plank bridge between the two floating octagons at z 76-80 (the gap is 48 m wide between platforms, 60 m above the gorge floor), exiting toward the rock pinnacle. The window ends as the deck passes overhead (proj: the bridge stays in frame until t 5.2). Ground 55-66 m below the lens the whole way.
